look: XORA site look, same as the V00 welcome film: deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet edges, fictional market lines drawing in, calm eased motion, the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: Checkpoint B
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 5 final checkpoint CPB, review of T14 to T23; a ring with a shield draws in; the tutor walks in.

scenes.name: How it works
scenes.desc: Eight questions from T14 to T23: read, pause, pick, countdown, see why. Not graded here; the graded quiz is in the interactive course.

scenes.name: Q1 reading a candle
scenes.desc: T14: open 60,000, high 60,300, low 59,800, close 60,200: a green candle whose body top is the close; 60,300 is the wick top.

scenes.name: Q2 building a 5-minute candle
scenes.desc: T15: five 1-minute candles become one 5-minute candle: first open, highest high, lowest low, last close; never an average.

scenes.name: Q3 breakout or fakeout
scenes.desc: T16/T17: price breaks above resistance and falls back within two candles: a possible fakeout, wait for evidence.

scenes.name: Q4 volume
scenes.desc: T18: a big green candle on high volume is one clue, not proof of direction; two possible next paths.

scenes.name: Q5 scalping costs
scenes.desc: T19: +0.80 gross and 1.00 fees per trade; ten trades net -2.00 USDT.

scenes.name: Q6 the NO_TRADE decision
scenes.desc: T20/T21: mid-range, flat trend, low volume, no level near: NO_TRADE; one green candle is not a reason.

scenes.name: Q7 position size
scenes.desc: T22: risk budget 10 USDT, stop 2% away: notional 10 / 2% = 500 USDT; 1,000 would risk 20.

scenes.name: Q8 after a losing demo trade
scenes.desc: T23: the stop slipped to -6.30 against -6 planned: journal it, check the process, take a break; no revenge trading.

scenes.name: Critical safety
scenes.desc: Leverage and liquidation, stops are triggers not promises, never share codes or keys, NO_TRADE and sizing from a risk budget.

scenes.name: Where to revisit
scenes.desc: Which lesson each question came from; rewatch with no penalty.

scenes.name: Course complete
scenes.desc: End card: congratulations on finishing; not a certification or permission to trade; keep practising in demo mode; XTINEX | XORA lockup.
